messages:
anya: Heads up — multiple EU customers seeing 403 on SSO after the KMS policy change yesterday. SCIM provisioning also flapping for RBAC role mappings. @oncall any idea?

devon: seeing same in logs. SAML assertions failing with audience mismatch and also decryption errors on stored provisioning tokens.

sre-gateway: logs:
```
ERROR saml: Assertion validation failed: audience != expected (got https://login.eu.redwood.example, want https://login.redwood.example)
ERROR scim: Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: 400
```

leo: KMS alias rotate was applied to alias/redwood-idp-key at 2026-03-19T22:40Z per infra change. Could be key-policy/bounce.

matt: can we confirm which services use that alias for encrypting SCIM tokens vs SAML session keys? I think identity-service and scim-worker both.

anya: yes identity-service uses it to sign SAML session keys (wrapped with envelope), scim-worker decrypts stored provisioning secrets.

devon: SCIM queue is piling up with 429 backpressure retries. Sample error in worker:
```
2026-03-19T23:05:12Z scim-worker ERROR Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException
Payload id: usr_1829 role_map_uuid: rm-3f2
```

matt: that InvalidCiphertextException usually means the plain key material changed (re-encrypt needed) or we used a different CMK. If alias re-pointed to new key without rewrapping data, decrypt will fail.

leo: potvrdit (confirm): IAM/Key policy change happened to block decrypt via the prior service role for a short window.

oncall-bot: @oncall page created: INC-2026-314 (SAML/SCIM degradation EU). Runbook: check alias, rewrap tokens, backfill retries.

devon: short mitigation: revert alias to previous key id (if available) to restore decryption immediately, then schedule rewrap.

anya: infra: can you check CloudTrail for UpdateAlias and who did it?

sre-gateway: found UpdateAlias by infra-automation@redwood-ci at 2026-03-19T22:39:48Z; commit id infra/rotations#c1e5. They intended to rotate but skipped rewrap step due to outage.

leo: ok we reverted alias at 23:15Z to previous key id. scim-worker now decrypts and queue draining. SAML audience still failing though.

matt: separate SAML audience mismatch looks like a proxy header rewrite in eu-auth-proxy; it changed assertion consumer URL host. Checking config.

devon: patch applied to eu-auth-proxy 23:20Z rolled back. after rollback SAML assertions accepted.

anya: TL;DR: root cause = two simultaneous changes (KMS alias rotate without rewrap + proxy host header change) caused SSO + SCIM errors. Mitigations: 1) revert alias (done), 2) rollback proxy (done), 3) run rewrap job for tokens, 4) backfill failed SCIM ops.

matt: follow-ups: add guardrail in infra rotation playbook to block alias switchover until rewrap job completes; add integration test for proxy header passthrough; add alert for InvalidCiphertextException rate spike.

leo: I'll open an RFC for rotation playbook updates and schedule a postmortem. Will include timeline and KMS key policy snippet.

security-bot: noted. Please attach CloudTrail diff and affected customer list to the incident ticket.

anya: customers notified via support. No escalations yet. Great work fast triaging, let's do RCA tomorrow.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-314 updated: status=mitigated, assigned=leo, rca_due=2026-03-22

matt: quick commands we ran:
```
# revert alias
aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/redwood-idp-key --target-key-id <old-key-id> --profile infra
# requeue scim worker
kubectl rollout restart deployment/scim-worker -n prod-eu
```

devon: notes for playbook: add `--force-rewrap` option to rewrap tool and add pre-check: verify service roles have decrypt permission on target key.

anya: ok closing thread here, will collect artifacts.
